inputs.modified_text: President John Mahama says national policy should reflect the law, culture, and collective agreement, and that he is committed to the rule of law as human-rights debates grow more complex. But “collective agreement” and cultural norms can’t be excuses to leave vulnerable people behind. The rule of law matters most when it protects everyone’s rights, including those with the least power to shape the consensus.
